_comment: What the setup prepares. Analysis skills are the ones the researcher uses; each lists the dependency skills it needs. Edit here (not in setup.py) when a skill gains or loses a dependency.

uv.purpose: runs every script of the analysis with fixed package versions

credentials.purpose: is required by the DeepMind skills (the key itself goes in the project .env through this setup)

alphagenome-variant-impact-score.purpose: gives the gene structure, the list of AlphaGenome tracks and the impact score of each variant

alphagenome-single-variant-analysis.purpose: interprets the top variants with the AlphaGenome model

alphagenome-atlas-website-links.purpose: links each top variant to its AlphaGenome Atlas page

embl-ebi-ols.purpose: finds the ontology terms (UBERON, CL) of the tissues

ensembl-database.purpose: gives the reference DNA sequence and the regulatory regions

alphagenome.purpose: gives the AlphaGenome Atlas scores per tissue

_agents_comment: The folder each agent app reads skills from, in the project and in the home folder (from the agent table of npx skills 1.9.0). A skill counts as installed for an agent only in one of its two folders; a copy anywhere else is not listed among that agent's skills.

network.affects: the first run of each script (packages are downloaded once)
the first run of each script
the gene's Regulatory Build and reference sequence (expression-analysis: exploration and study step 3)
finding the ontology terms of the tissues
